builder.empty: Nothing selected yet. Choose a template or tick components.
builder.heading: Build a scenario
builder.intro: Start from a template, or tick the components of your energy system.
builder.wip: Work in progress: the forms for the settings of each component and the upload of time series come next. Until then you can see below what is still missing, and open a complete scenario file further down.
check.battery_no_source: {component} has nothing to charge from. Add a grid connection, PV or wind.
check.c_rate: {component}: the charge/discharge rate (C-rate) must be greater than 0.
check.capacity_factor: {component}: the generation profile has values up to {maximum}, but a capacity factor is at most 1 (output per installed kW). A profile downloaded for a larger system has to be divided by its size.
check.chp_efficiency_sum: {component}: electrical + thermal efficiency ({total}) cannot be greater than 1.
check.chp_no_heat_demand: {component} always produces heat as well. Without a heat demand the heat cannot be used and the plant will not run.
check.chp_only_heat_source: {component} is the only heat source and its electricity cannot be exported. If heat demand is high compared to electricity demand the model can become infeasible.
check.cop_missing: {component}: no COP time series uploaded. Upload a file or use a constant COP instead.
check.cop_not_positive: {component}: the constant COP must be greater than 0.
check.demand_no_supply: {component} has no supply. Add a grid connection (or PV or wind).
check.efficiency: {component}: the efficiency must be greater than 0.
check.efficiency_electrical: {component}: the electrical efficiency must be greater than 0.
check.efficiency_thermal: {component}: the thermal efficiency must be greater than 0.
check.feedin_above_lowest_price: The feed-in tariff ({tariff} €/kWh) is higher than the lowest electricity price in the series ({price} €/kWh). The model could buy and sell electricity at the same time for unlimited profit and cannot be solved. Please check the prices and their units.
check.feedin_above_price: The feed-in tariff ({tariff} €/kWh) is higher than the electricity price ({price} €/kWh). The model could buy and sell electricity at the same time for unlimited profit and cannot be solved. Please check the prices and their units.
check.feedin_unused: {component} is selected, but nothing feeds electricity into it.
check.fixed_needs_capacity: {component}: fixed mode needs a capacity greater than 0 (or set the mode to 'invest').
check.gas_unused: {component} is selected, but no component uses gas.
check.grid_price_empty: {component}: the price series contains empty values. Please check the selected column.
check.grid_price_missing: {component}: no price time series uploaded. Upload a file or use a constant price instead.
check.grid_price_short: {component}: the price series has {count} values, but the selected time range needs {needed}. Upload a longer series or shorten the time range.
check.heat_not_supplied: {component} cannot be supplied. It needs a working heat source: a gas boiler or CHP plant together with a gas import, or a heat pump or heating rod together with electricity from the grid or PV.
check.no_demand: No demand selected. Add an electricity demand or a heat demand.
check.no_fuel: {component} has no fuel supply and cannot run.
check.no_heat_demand: {component} is selected, but there is no heat demand.
check.profile_missing: {component}: no time series uploaded. Upload a time series for it.
check.profile_shares: {component}: the demand profile adds up to {total}, but shares of the annual demand must add up to 1 over a year. Check the profile, or choose 'The demand in kW'.
check.renewables_alone.one: {components} alone cannot cover demand at all times. Without a grid connection (or enough storage) the model may be infeasible.
check.renewables_alone.other: {components} alone cannot cover demand at all times. Without a grid connection (or enough storage) the model may be infeasible.
check.series_invalid: {component}: the selected time series contains empty or non-numeric values. Please check the selected column.
check.series_long: {component}: the time series has {count} values, but the selected time range needs {needed}. Only the first {needed} values will be used.
check.series_short: {component}: the time series has {count} values, but the selected time range needs {needed}. Upload a longer series or shorten the time range.
check.surplus_not_exported: Surplus electricity from {components} cannot be exported. With a fixed capacity the model can become infeasible when production is higher than what is used.

file_error.damaged: This file is not a scenario saved by this tool, or it is damaged ({where}: {message}).
file_error.json: This file is not valid JSON. Choose a scenario file saved by this tool.
file_error.newer: This scenario was saved with a newer version of the tool. Please update the tool to open it.
file_error.old: This scenario file is in an old format that this version cannot open.
file_error.result: This looks like a saved result, not a scenario. Results are opened in the Streamlit interface under 'Open a saved result'.
findings.fix_errors: Fix the errors above before the optimization can start.
findings.passed: System check passed. Ready to optimize.
findings.title: System check
findings.warnings_only: There are warnings but no errors. The optimization can be started.
hint.start: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD (for example 2021-01-01), in the years {first} to {last}.
hint.steps: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
open.heading: Open a scenario file
open.intro: Or open a scenario that was saved earlier. A scenario file (JSON) holds the components, settings and time series of one energy system. Examples are in the folder examples/scenarios_v2.
result.heading: Results
run.failed: The optimization could not be completed: {reason}
run.heading: Run the optimization
run.intro: The optimization runs in the background, so the page stays usable. A full year can take from a few seconds up to a minute.
run.unexpected: The optimization stopped unexpectedly. Please try again; if it happens again, tell the developers.
scenario.heading: Your scenario
scenario.name: Name
scenario.period_hint: The model works in hourly steps: 24 steps are one day, {year} are a year.
